func TestManagedMemberManifestSecurityMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	base := mmManifest(t)
	check := func(t *testing.T, name string, patchDirs bool) {
		t.Helper()
		f := base.clone(t)
		member := mmMap(mmMap(f.manifest["members"])["a"])
		config := mmMap(member["guest_config"])
		runtime := mmMap(config["runtime"])
		credential := mmMap(runtime["live_s3_credential"])
		scope := mmMap(mmMap(config["member"])["scope"])
		want := "runtime pins"
		switch name {
		case "wrong_peer":
			b := mmMap(mmMap(mmMap(f.manifest["members"])["b"])["guest_config"])
			mmMap(b["runtime"])["replication_peer_member_id"] = mmID("b")
		case "s3_config_hash":
			runtime["live_s3_config_sha256"] = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
		case "s3_target_hash":
			runtime["live_s3_target_sha256"] = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
		case "credential_version_2":
			credential["version_number"] = 2
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_version_bool":
			credential["version_number"] = true
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_version_float":
			credential["version_number"] = jsontext.Value(`1.0`)
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_ocid":
			credential["secret_ocid"] = mmSecret + "-other"
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "shard_zero":
			scope["shard_id"] = 0
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_bool":
			scope["shard_id"] = true
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_negative":
			scope["shard_id"] = -1
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_overflow":
			scope["shard_id"] = jsontext.Value(`18446744073709551616`)
			want = "scope"
		case "lowercase_tenant":
			scope["tenant_id"] = strings.ToLower(scope["tenant_id"].(string))
			want = "scope"
		case "runtime_directory":
			want = "runtime directory"
		case "s3_endpoint", "s3_region":
			record := mmMap(mmMap(member["inputs"])["signed_v2_s3_config"])
			s3 := mmObject{"version": 1, "ack_profile": "object_durable", "bucket": "tbmm-" + strings.Repeat("2", 32), "region": mmRegion, "endpoint": mmEndpoint}
			if name == "s3_endpoint" {
				s3["endpoint"] = "http://rustfs.terrabase.test:9000"
			} else {
				s3["region"] = "us-east-1"
			}
			payload := mmJSON(t, s3)
			record["path"] = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "a-signed-v2-s3-config.json")
			script.Write(t, record["path"].(string), payload, 0o600)
			record["sha256"] = mmSHA(payload)
			runtime["live_s3_config_sha256"] = record["sha256"]
			want = "signed S3 target"
		}
		_, e := f.load(t, patchDirs)
		if name == "valid" {
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		} else {
			mmReject(t, e, want)
		}
	}
	// The production runtime directories must reject the fixture's scope.
	t.Run("runtime_directory", func(t *testing.T) { check(t, "runtime_directory", false) })
	t.Run("pinned", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Cleanup(mmPatchDirs(base.dirs))
		for _, name := range []string{"valid", "wrong_peer", "s3_config_hash", "s3_target_hash", "credential_version_2", "credential_version_bool", "credential_version_float", "credential_ocid", "s3_endpoint", "s3_region", "shard_zero", "shard_bool", "shard_negative", "shard_overflow", "lowercase_tenant"} {
			t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
				t.Parallel()
				check(t, name, false)
			})
		}
	})
}

package firecracker

import "strings"

const managedVolumeSetupScriptA = `#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DEVICE=/dev/vdb
ALIAS=/dev/oracleoci/oraclevdb
MOUNT=__MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/volume
UUID=76f1b43d-7d79-4f41-9a6e-cc1f4aaab102
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 120 ]; do
  if [ -b "$DEVICE" ] && [ -e "/dev/disk/by-uuid/$UUID" ] &&
     [ "$(readlink -f "/dev/disk/by-uuid/$UUID")" = "$DEVICE" ]; then break; fi
  attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 0.5
done
[ "$attempt" -lt 120 ] || exit 1
[ "$(/usr/sbin/blkid -s UUID -o value "$DEVICE")" = "$UUID" ] || exit 1
for directory in /srv/ts-managed __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__ __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/material __MANAGED_MEMBER_DIR__/control "$MOUNT"; do
  [ ! -L "$directory" ] && [ -d "$directory" ] || exit 1
done
[ ! -e /dev/oracleoci ] || [ -d /dev/oracleoci ] || exit 1
mkdir -p /dev/oracleoci
[ ! -e "$ALIAS" ] && [ ! -L "$ALIAS" ] || exit 1
ln -s ../vdb "$ALIAS"
if findmnt -rn -S "$DEVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || mountpoint -q "$MOUNT"; then exit 1; fi
mount -t ext4 -o rw "$ALIAS" "$MOUNT"
[ "$(findmnt -n -o TARGET --source "$DEVICE")" = "$MOUNT" ] || exit 1
[ "$(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE --target "$MOUNT")" = ext4 ] || exit 1
chown 0:65534 "$MOUNT"; chmod 0750 "$MOUNT"
[ ! -e "$MOUNT/.terrascale-member-claim" ] || exit 1
mkdir -m 0700 "$MOUNT/data" "$MOUNT/replication"
chown 65534:65534 "$MOUNT/data" "$MOUNT/replication"
`

const managedRunnerScriptA = `#!/bin/sh
set -u
LOG=/var/log/ts-managed-member/go-host-test.log
mkdir -p /var/log/ts-managed-member
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 120 ]; do
  if ip -4 -o addr show | grep -Fq '10.77.39.11/24'; then break; fi
  attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 0.5
done
if [ "$attempt" -ge 120 ]; then
  echo 'TS_MANAGED_MEMBER_QUALIFICATION_RESULT=FAILED status=90'
  systemctl --no-block reboot || true
  exit 90
fi
TS_FC_MANAGED_MEMBER_CONFIG=/etc/ts-managed-member/guest-config.json \
TS_FC_MANAGED_S3_ACCESS_KEY_FILE=/etc/ts-managed-member/s3-access-key-id \
TS_FC_MANAGED_S3_SECRET_KEY_FILE=/etc/ts-managed-member/s3-secret-access-key \
  /opt/ts-managed-member/host.test -test.run='^TestManagedMemberFirecrackerSignedServing$' -test.v -test.timeout=480s > "$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
cat "$LOG"
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'TS_MANAGED_MEMBER_QUALIFICATION_RESULT=PASS node=node-a'
else
  echo 'TS_MANAGED_MEMBER_QUALIFICATION_RESULT=FAILED status='"$status"
fi
sync
systemctl --no-block reboot || true
exit "$status"
`

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator host runtime
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Availability first: the restart backoff below reaches its 5min cap after
# seven starts (about 10 minutes), so at most about 17 starts fit in any hour
# and a loop at the capped backoff never reaches this burst; the host keeps
# retrying through a controller outage of any length. The limit only fails a
# runtime that restarts faster than that backoff (for example after a manual
# reset-failed), and the host-setup timer starts a failed runtime again.
StartLimitIntervalSec=1h
StartLimitBurst=20

[Service]
# READY=1 once the host is connected to its regional cell. No WatchdogSec=:
# restarting this process stops every supervised TerraBase member.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
TimeoutStartSec=3min
# Runs as root by default: User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make
# systemd drop CAP_SETUID, which the native workload helper needs.
SupplementaryGroups=
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator host --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Protect the host manager without throttling the managed database when idle.
# MemoryMin/MemoryLow come from the image profile; the native runner copies
# those floors to the supervisor subgroup.
CPUSchedulingPolicy=other
Nice=-20
CPUWeight=10000
IOWeight=10000
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=0
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
ManagedOOMPreference=omit
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
RestartSteps=6
RestartMaxDelaySec=5min
TimeoutStopSec=90s
KillSignal=SIGTERM
KillMode=control-group
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitCORE=0
UMask=0077
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-host
StateDirectoryMode=0755
Delegate=yes
DelegateSubgroup=supervisor
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_KILL CAP_SETGID CAP_SETUID CAP_SETPCAP CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
# A custom root needs a drop-in that resets this list before adding its exact path.
ReadWritePaths=-/srv/ts-managed
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=no
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

func head(v string, n int) string { return v[:min(n, len(v))] }
func hashBytes(v []byte) string   { s := sha256.Sum256(v); return hex.EncodeToString(s[:]) }
